positions.name: AsyncRememberContract
positions.frame: How does the async remember contract handle non-blocking dispatch and result delivery?
positions.why: Both expressions define the asynchronous execution and communication lifecycle for remember calls: src-1 establishes the ratified contract of returning an immediate receipt and watching extraction via polling without blocking or data loss, while src-2 elaborates the dispatch and delivery mechanics (polling vs. piggybacked reactions on subsequent calls).
